reviews.text: Amazing staff! They always do such a great job!
They are great , I take my dogs there every week before puppy yoga
They provide amazing poodle cuts.

Doria is an awesome groomer! Not only is she awesome, she is knowledgeable and always so sweet. Her team along with Michelle are the best, always going above and beyond. They always provide service with a smile. I would never go anywhere else. They are the best!!!!

Just took my 3yr old sheepadoodle here for the first time and had Alice as his groomer. She did a wonderful job 👏 the customer service was top tier 👏  they even gave us a report card for my dog and a little goodie bag because it was our first time. I will be taking him back 10 out of 10 i do recommend!

Our dog Moose is a mini golden doodle, he is groomed by Alice! She does such a beautiful job grooming moose, making sure he is calm and happy during his grooming! Alice watched moose for a weekend, she sent updates with pictures. Moose was so happy! Alice is the best, I can’t thank her enough for doing such an amazing job with Moose!
Alice was amazing. All my dogs loved it, even the ones that did not like grooming before this.

I absolutely love it here! Rescued our guy a month ago and he was in need of a groom - he can be super nervous at times so we were worried how he would do and come to find out he did great because they go over the cutest report card at the end of the groom when you pick your pet up! They also gave him the cutest goody bag. Will definitely return and will recommend to anyone looking for a groomer! 10/10 experience. Great price, great communication, great staff. He looks amazing!! Thank you guys for everything that you guys do. Posted some before and after pics 🖤 Ozzy loved his spa day! 😊

The grooming was done perfectly — my dog looked adorable and was clearly well cared for. Christina is kind, professional, and truly loves what she does. Clean space, great attention to detail, and such a positive experience overall. Highly recommend!

1st time here & what a great experience my little guy was so happy especially when he got home to open the Xmas present they gave him at salon. I will recommend to everyone I know and so happy my neighbors told me about this place!!!!!!!❤️
Our dog gets very good and professional treatment

My dog Sophie has been to this salon several times and always returned to me absolutely gorgeous!! She actually comes to me calm and so very pretty! Doria even accommodated a last minute grooming appointment one of the times. The care and love for my dog was truly astounding! This will definitely be the place for your dog as this is the forever place for mine. So happy it was highly recommended! Thank you Doria, etc al. I appreciate you and your staff! What an absolute pleasure!!!

I’ve been coming here for years with my dogs, and the care has always been exceptional. The team truly treats my pups like family, and the owner, Doria, goes above and beyond every single time. Highly recommend this place to all pet owners!
Took my mini poodle for a full bath & groom great experience smooth service super sweet friendly

Alice, the groomer is just amazing.  She was able to cut my older, grouchy, hard to handle shorkie’s beyond knotted hair. She also did my younger energetic poodle.  I have nothing but good things to say about this place.  The price was reasonable and my pets look amazing. Thank you!!

I've been going to Christina's Pet Styles for many years. Marie, the groomer, is an asset to the store. Her work is excellent, professional, and she has extreme patience in dealing with pets. She is compassionate and her work is outstanding. I highly recommend her because her service and experience is exceptional!!
This was our first visit and we are very pleased with how good our pomapoo looks! Very reasonably priced. We were suprised. Very friendly professional service. We will be going back when time comes.
I've been bringing my maltipo here since he's 7 months old. He's now 2 and a half. Love bringing my dog here. Fast appointments, perfect care, and great staff !

I cannot express enough gratitude. My dog looks amazing. His coat requires a unique stripping technique, he is also super energetic and not easy to handle.  Hard work and priced very reasonably. Thank you Doria, you are the best! We will definitely be back.

Christina Petstyles is hands down the best pet grooming salon we’ve ever been to! The staff is incredibly caring, professional, and talented. My dog Palermo absolutely loves going there , he’s always happy to see Dori and comes home looking and feeling great. Highly Recommend!
Papillon dog groom
Super caring for your pets and able to handle difficult dogs! Great staff and owners!
Have been going to Christina’s pet styles for 5 years, they do a great job always!

They did a great job for my mini poodle! Very professional, nice, friendly, clean, and affordable. I'll definitely be returning. My dog is very neatly groomed. They provide a report card at the end of the visit, treats, a bandana and a little toy which he loves!
Love to bring my buddy to there! Every times they did I a great job ! Love it

Our first time taking our dog to Christina’s and were so happy from the minute we walked in the door.
We will definitely be back!
Christina's has taken care of our Goldie and now our Mor and Toby. They know how to calm them, clean them and love them. We always use their wonderful services!
Super nice staff.  Love, Sugar🐶 …
Christina's Pet Styles is reasonably priced ,always kind and gives a quality cut.

My dog got a full service grooming, and as her first time she did a great job and they said she cooperated well. They did a nice job in cleaning her up and making her look nice and refreshed. And the place was nicely decorated for the holiday season. Very cute photo op for dogs, but mine didn’t want to stay still😂 …

Christina’s Pet Styles is the best! Doria and her team are so nice and friendly—they always make you and your pets feel welcome. They do such an awesome job, and my ralphie always comes out looking great 😎. You can tell they really care about the animals, and the shop is super clean and comfy too. …
Great service! Amazing haircut for my Shi Tzu! Very cute and thoughtful goodie bag 😊 Highly recommend! …
They are the best on the island. Been coming here for 10 years . Always perfect and they take such good care of the pups.
Small business grooming they are wonderful!

Lovely experience, my Shitzu was extremely nervous after visiting a different groomer. A family member recommended Christina's place, and I got to say I'm thankful that I gave it a try. My baby came back normal and happy. They also gave my pets a treat bag. Thank you for taking good care of my Onyx. He's definitely going to be a regular there.

We have been bringing our dog here for about a year or so and love it.  It is a cute little place that seems clean.  The staff is friendly and very accommodating especially when I needed a last minute appointment.

Today we had our first visit to Christina’s pet styles! Before I went in I called over the phone and the woman I spoke to was super kind and informative. I brought goose in the same day for a very needed grooming appointment. She was ready about an hour later and she looked amazing!  They gave us a little report card for gooses first visit and it was so sweet. They gave us a welcome goody bag and I just feel they went above and beyond with my pup. She looks and smells great and we are both very happy.

My pup ( Bernedoodle) has been going to Christina’s since he was a baby (2 years now) . We love and appreciate the staff who do an amazing job every single time. Doria, my pups groomer always leaves my pup looking and smelling phenomenal . …
The works at Christina's are great and make my Stella look beautiful and smell great!!! Recommend their services for dogs and cats !!
